entries.text: Yo yo yo yo, Champ in the making. Guess you’re\nalmost a Champ in the made.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_01

entries.text: Sorry for the holdup. I’m back.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_02

entries.text: That’s the BB League Elite Four all beaten!\nYou schooled every Elite One of us.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_03

entries.text: Crispin’s no pushover—he’s just super\nstraightforward.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_a_01

entries.text: I think that’s kinda part of his charm, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_a_02

entries.text: We used to all chow down on Crispin’s cooking\nafter club activities let out. Those were the days.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_a_03

entries.text: Guess he’s been worrying about the way things\nare, too, in his own way.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_a_04

entries.text: Amarys sure leaves an impression, huh?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_b_01

entries.text: It’s wild seeing her and Carmine talk. You’d never\nguess it, but they click in a weird way. It’s pretty\r\nfunny to watch.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_b_02

entries.text: The thing about Amarys is, as rigid as she looks,\nshe’s got a sensitive streak a mile wide.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_b_03

entries.text: Remember that about her, OK? Even if it’s hard\nto tell from outside.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_b_04

entries.text: Lacey’s all about cuteness—and that’s what helps\nher make her Pokémon stronger.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_c_01

entries.text: She’s so into her team, training the little cuties\ndoesn’t even feel like work to her. Wild, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_c_02

entries.text: I bet it’s the same for you, huh? You work so hard\nat it ’cause you like it![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_c_03

entries.text: Unlike a certain someone who seems busy\nrunning himself and everyone around him into\r\nthe ground just to get a bit stronger.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_c_04

entries.text: Y’know, Lacey’s polite to everyone else, but\nshe’s really blunt with me... I wonder why?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_c_05

entries.text: Here’s your reward, like I said.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_d_01

entries.text: Guess I should’ve cleaned it, but what’s a little\ndust between friends?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_d_02

entries.text: Man, it’s like I blinked and you’d plowed through\nthe whole BB League.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_04

entries.text: You know what’s next for you, right, bud?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_05

entries.text: You’re good enough to beat all Elite Four of us...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_06

entries.text: So you, and only you, have the right to challenge\nthe sitting BB League Champion, Kieran![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_07

entries.text: You really kept me waiting.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_01

entries.text: Took you a while to beat the Elite Four. Kind of\nslow for you, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_02

entries.text: Nice, Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_13

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You’ve really got [VAR 0x0100(0000)]
on
the
brain, huh?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_14

entries.text: I could say the same thing about you, Drayton.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_03

entries.text: You sure are putting a lot of effort into helping\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] out.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_04

entries.text: Who wouldn’t help out a new student?\nGotta be good to our fellow humans.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_15

entries.text: That’s rich coming from you...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_05

entries.text: Whatever you’re planning, it’s about to come\nto an end.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_06

entries.text: Let’s settle who’s the strongest between us two,\nonce and for all.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_08

entries.text: You’ll be battling the best of the best now. I’ll be\nwaiting.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_brother_09

entries.text: It’s finally time. I’m pumped for you.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_16

entries.text: We’ll have to go sign you up at the front desk\nto get your Championship match going.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_11

entries.text: No sense waiting around. Let’s go![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0170_dragonbb_12
